name: AI Site Scan
description: Free check of how well ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI can reach, read and understand a website. It gives a score from 0 to 100, a side-by-side AI view, a test of 14 AI bots, 23 agent-readiness checks and a ranked fix list. The full report costs $19 once for one site, or $29 a month for Pro with 10 reports a month. Reports are emailed and saved in the buyer's account.
